items.label: Micron post-earnings analyst call 2026 (09-30-2026)
items.signal_prefix: CTO Scott DeBoer: Micron's technology leadership is 'at least two nodes ahead

set.signal: CTO Scott DeBoer: Micron's technology leadership is 'at least two nodes ahead of the China competition'; 1-gamma DRAM is already the majority of Micron's bits and set to be the largest node in company history, and depends on EUV; the next node, 1-delta, is well underway with focus on its ramp 'in the second half of next year'. DeBoer says front-end process differences between DRAM optimized for HBM, SOCAMM, LPDRAM and GDDR6 on the same node are 'probably more difference than ever in the history of DRAM'; COO Manish Bhatia says running them on the same lines lets Micron flex mix to demand, though not necessarily lowering cost. Bhatia: China exposure has been falling and is expected to be in the single-digit range in fiscal 2027.

items.reason: DeBoer hedged the process-difference claim ('probably more difference than ever'); the entry stated it flatly as 'larger than ever'
items.evidence: there's, at this moment in time, probably more difference than ever in the history of DRAM.

items.label: PDF Solutions Q2 FY2026 (08-06-2026)
items.signal_prefix: eProbe / DirectScan: PDF placed three new eProbe e-beam inspection machines

set.signal: eProbe / DirectScan: PDF placed three new eProbe e-beam inspection machines in Q2: two with new customers (one an evaluation, one a five-year subscription) and one at a new factory of an existing customer under a previously signed contract; with the Q1 shipment that is two-thirds of the way to the year's goal. The five-year subscription customer uses DirectScan on a more mature process node, which CEO John Kibarian says demonstrates DirectScan's value in mature nodes; the evaluation takes PDF into the memory market, which he calls an important beachhead, while noting such evaluations typically take close to a year to convert and declining to speculate on when or if it will. CEO: the DirectScan customer set is expanding and is 'definitely bigger than what we thought'; geographic expansion will be looked at later this year or early next year; 2027 production targets may be communicated by later this year.

items.reason: 'five to 10 customers' was the analyst's (D.A. Davidson) framing in the question, not stated or confirmed by management
items.evidence: Clark Wright: Roughly a year ago, you noted that the target audience for DirectScan systems was five to 10 customers.
